mechanism: Ginkgo biloba inhibits platelet aggregation and has anticoagulant properties, which may potentiate bleeding risk when combined with piperacillin-tazobactam, which can cause thrombocytopenia and platelet dysfunction as an adverse effect.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding (ecchymosis, petechiae, hematuria, GI bleeding); consider discontinuing ginkgo biloba during piperacillin-tazobactam therapy or use alternative antibiotic if bleeding risk is high.
